ev.q: Fewer than half of members of the restaurant staffs surveyed in 278 restaurants had received training on food allergies.
Fewer than half of the 277 restaurant managers (44.4%), 211 food workers (40.8%), and 156 servers (33.3%) interviewed reported receiving food allergy training.
Among managers, 55.2% reported that their restaurants had ingredient lists or recipes for all or most menu items
